identification: Eminar (Melbourne/Northcote, 1970s) valve guitar amplifier head, black vinyl case, silver/chrome front panel. Two channels: channel 1 Volume/Treble/Bass, channel 2 Volume/Treble/Mid/Bass, plus tremolo section (Speed, Intensity, Frequency), Standby and Power toggle switches, input jacks across the lower panel. This matches the Eminar 'Silverface w/Tremolo' head (cover listings use that name). Model number and wattage are NOT readable on the panel in the only photo (800x600 original). Comparable Eminar valve heads of this era are 4xEL34 and about 100W (one 1970 Eminar listed as 100W with EL34s), so likely about 100W, unconfirmed. Lot also includes a Gorilla GG-20C Chorus 1989 practice amp and a coil of leads. 'Amp power on' per title.
marks_seen: Reopened the only photo (images/products/1637534_1.jpg; _2, _3 and _0 return 404) at its native 800x600, then enlarged to 3x and read the panel. EMINAR logo clear. Control labels: channel 1 VOLUME TREBLE BASS; channel 2 VOLUME TREBLE MIDDLE BASS; SPEED, INTENSITY, FREQUENCY (tremolo); STANDBY ON/OFF, POWER ON/OFF. No model number, wattage or serial visible; rear and underside not photographed. Small amp: Gorilla logo, GG-20C Chorus.
google_searches: Eminar amplifier head vintage Australian (Reverb, OzValveAmps, Clingan); 'Eminar silverface tremolo amp head' (cover listings call this style Silverface w/Tremolo; Weztech lists a 1970 Eminar 100W amp w/ EL34s); Eminar valve amplifier head auction (Invaluable lot 42 'Vintage Eminar 3 piece PA system', est A$50-100, sold price hidden behind login; Facebook posts: Eminar PA 100w valve A$1,300 ask, Apollo 80 start $900, not verified sales).

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 30-50, current bid $20 (rechecked 9 Nov). This is the lot that matters. Eminar valve heads have sold on eBay AU at A$574 (30 Sep 2025, working-looking, same panel style), A$251 (Dec 2023, NOT working), and A$210 (May 2026, H1062 PA head). Typical A$200-575 for the head, plus about A$60-120 for the Gorilla GG-20C. Only 3 close sales in 3 years, so thin. At viewing: look for a rear plate or underside label for model and wattage, count output valves (4 x EL34 = about 100W), check mains transformer, power cord and valves, and ask staff to switch it on (title says amp power on). Heavy, about 15-20 kg, posting is costly; local pickup or courier. Price trend: modest rise on the one working sale, thin data. Most prices under 3 years old.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU 3yr: 'eminar amplifier' (1 row), 'eminar amp' (1 row), 'eminar' (7 rows), 'gorilla gg-20c' (2 rows). eBay public item pages for 267420051352, 235309391397, 227317347402. Reverb sold filter 'eminar' (0), Reverb live 'eminar amplifier' (3 live). Google: Eminar silverface tremolo; Eminar auction sites. Invaluable search 'eminar amplifier' (0 items shown), Invaluable lot 42 'Vintage Eminar 3 piece PA System' seen via Google only (sold price behind login). LiveAuctioneers page failed to load.
flip_reason: 3 close or same-maker head sales in 3 years (A$574, A$251, A$210) plus Gorilla sold A$121. If the head is a working 100W silverface, resale about A$300-575 vs bid $20 (cost about $122 at $100 hammer incl 22% premium). Condition and wattage unverified, one small photo only, heavy to post. Not an easy flip; possible $200+ profit only if it works.
